      BUSINESS REVIEW                                                                 業務回顧

      Starting from January 1, 2019, the Group recognised an existing business        自2019年1月1日起，本集團將一項現有業務

Exhaust Gas Management       •   The coal storage unit was completely enclosed for transformation, and the enclosed
廢氣管理                             dust removal facilities were installed for the intermediate links of powder materials and
                                 products such as coal transport, coal pulverizing, coal loading, coke pushing, coke
                                 quenching, coke screening, and ammonium sulphate drying to reduce the release of
                                 particulate matters such as coal dust and dust;
                             •   儲煤單元實施全封閉改造，同時對煤轉運、煤粉碎、裝煤、推焦、熄焦、篩焦、硫銨乾
                                 燥等粉轉物料、產品的流轉環節安裝封閉、除塵設施減少煤塵、粉塵等顆粒物的逸散；

                             •   Adopt advanced and stable desulfurization, denitration, and dust removal technologies
                                 at the end of the production process to realize ultralow emission;
                             •   生產工藝的末端採用工藝先進、運行穩定脫硫、脫硝、除塵工藝，實現超低排放；

                             •   Adopt leak detection and repair technology for oil and gas pipelines, oil storage
                                 facilities and equipment to reduce VOCs emissions;
                             •   對油氣管線及儲油設施、設備推行洩露檢測修復技術，減少VOCs排放；

                             •   The pond of the sewage treatment station was sealed and the exhaust gas was
                                 released up to the standards after collection and treatment;
                             •   污水處理站池體加蓋密封，產生的廢氣經收集處理後達標排放；

                             •   The construction camp of the renovation and expansion project was equipped with
                                 hard fence, and effective dust prevention and reduction measures such as covering,
                                 sprinkling and dust suppression, washing the ground and vehicles were adopted;
                                 speed limit of vehicles at the entrance and exit of the construction site, road hardening
                                 or watering were adopted to ensure that the ground was wet and reduce the dust
                                 generated by vehicles.
                             •   改擴建項目的施工營地設置硬質圍擋，並採取覆蓋灑水抑塵、沖洗地面和車輛等有效防
                                 塵、降塵措施；施工場地出入口車輛限速，道路硬化或灑水沖洗保證地面濕潤，減少車
                                 輛行駛產生的揚塵。

                                     全部返回生產系統綜合利用或作為產品外售，防止因危險廢物排放造成的對環境的影
                                     響；

                                 •   Qualified units were entrusted for safe and proper disposal of the hazardous wastes,
                                     and the production base were all equipped with hazardous waste repositories that
                                     meet The National Pollution Control Standard for Storage of Hazard Wastes ;
                                 •   危險廢物委託有資質單位進行安全妥善處置，各生產園區均建設有符合《危險廢物貯存污
                                     染控制標準》的危險廢物暫存庫；

                                 •   The household garbage among the general solid waste was delivered to the municipal
                                     sanitation departments for unified disposal. For those that can be recycled and
                                     utilized, such as the fly ash and slags, enter into a cooperation agreement with a third
                                     party to carry out comprehensive utilization and turn the wastes into resources.
                                 •   一般固體廢物中的生活垃圾交由城市環衛部門進行統一處置，粉煤灰、爐渣等具備回收
                                     利用價值的與第三方簽訂合作協議，進行綜合利用，實現廢物資源化。

Example:   Carry out transformation for ultralow emission and facilitate the Battle for Blue Sky
案例：        實施超低排放改造，助力藍天保衛戰


           For continuing the Battle for Blue Sky and actively responding to the Program for In-depth Emission Reduction
           of Steel Works, Coking and Coal-Fired Power Plants in Hebei Province, the Group, in 2019, actively carried out
           the transformation for ultralow emission and the flue gas desulfurization and denitration projects to effectively
           remove the SO2, NOX, and particulate matters in the flue gas of the coke oven, which can reduce NOx by
           2948 tons/year, SO2 by 280 tons/year, and particulate matter by 70 tons/year, as well as recovered residual
           heat of the flue gas to reduce emissions for the environmental benefits; in terms of controlling the unorganized
           emission of the coal yard, we enclosed the coal yard for transformation to further reduce the dust release
           from the coal yard and improved the working environment of employees; in terms of advanced treatment of
           wastewater, we carried out advanced treatment of the coking wastewater, and recycled the treated reclaimed
           water for the circulating water unit, which reduced the discharge of process wastewater and saved the
           consumption of fresh water, saving a total of 501,197 tons of water in 2019; in addition, we implemented the
           in-deep emission reduction project for the coal-fired power plant of Cangzhou Risun Chemicals. On the basis
           of ultra-low emission of the original project, we extended the service life of the desulfurization unit through a
           series of improvement measures, and improved the denitration reaction efficiency, so as to meet the limit of
           the reference acceptance standard for in-deep emission reduction of coal-fired plants in Hebei province. The
           Group actively implements the concept of green development, takes multiple measures to create synergy,
           and contributes to the improvement of regional environment.

           為持續打響藍天保衛戰，積極響應《河北省鋼鐵、焦化、燃煤電廠深度減排攻堅方案》，2019年，本集團積極
           開展超低排放改造，實施開展煙氣脫硫脫硝工程，有效脫除焦爐煙氣中的NO X 、SO 2 及顆粒物，可實現減排
           NOx2948噸╱年、SO2減排280噸╱年、顆粒物70噸╱年，同時回收煙氣余熱，達到減少排放的環保效益；在控
           制煤場無組織排放方面，我們實施煤場全封閉改造項目，進一步減少了煤場揚塵的逸散，改善了員工作業環境；
           在廢水深度處理方面，我們對焦化廢水進行深度治理，處理後的中水回用於循環水單元，減少了工藝廢水的外
           排，節約了新鮮水的消耗，2019年共實現節水501,197噸；此外，我們對滄州旭陽化工燃煤電廠實施了深度減排
           項目，在原項目超低排放的基礎之上，通過一系列改進措施延長了脫硫裝置使用壽命，提高了脫硝反應效率，達
           到河北省燃煤電廠深度減排驗收參照標準限值要求。本集團積極踐行綠色發展理念，多措並舉、形成合力，為區
           域環境的改善貢獻力量。

Example:    Implement technical transformation for energy saving to reduce the costs and increase the benefits
案例：         實施節能技改，實現降本增效


            Adhering to the concept of green development, the Group continued to explore the potential and space of
            energy saving and consumption reduction, so as to reduce the costs and increase the benefits by technical
            transformation for energy saving. In 2019, Cangzhou Risun Chemicals. implemented the expansion and
            renovation project and the project of replacing coal gas with surplus vapor to further improve the efficiency
            of plants, improve the utilization efficiency of resources and energy, and reduce the coal gas consumption,
            which did not only reduce the manufacturing cost per unit product, but also greatly reduce the greenhouse
            gas emissions, reducing emissions of about 5291 tons.
            本集團秉持綠色發展的理念，不斷挖掘節能降耗潛力，探尋節能降耗空間，以節能技改推動降本增效。2019
            年，滄州旭陽化工實施了擴能改造項目、富余蒸汽替代煤氣項目，進一步提升了裝置效能，提高了資源、能源的
            利用效率，減少了煤氣的消耗，不僅降低了單位產品的製造成本，而且也大幅降低了溫室氣體的排放，實現減排
            量約5291噸。

                                   In 2019, Cangzhou Risun Chemicals undertook the Cangzhou City Emergency Drill for
                                   Environmental Emergency. The background of the drill was the hazardous chemical leakage
                                   in the chemical storage tank area. The drill covered such actions as receipt of incident report,
                                   early handled by enterprises, which dispatched environmental emergency response forces,
                                   and took on-site coordinated handling. In the process of preparation, participants continuously
                                   improved and refined the drill plan to fit the actual scenario as closely as possible. After the
                                   drill began, the fire brigade, medical rescue team, environmental monitoring team, emergency
                                   repair team, process team and other emergency rescue teams quickly gathered, resolutely
                                   implemented a series of actions such as plugging, spraying, fire-fighting, and rescue to achieve
                                   efficient and orderly cooperation. The drill further improved the ability of the enterprise to deal with
                                   environmental emergencies and laid a solid foundation for protecting environmental safety.
                                   2019年，滄州旭陽化工承辦了滄州市突發環境事件應急演練，演練背景以化工倉儲罐區發生危險化
                                   學品洩漏為背景，演練涵蓋事件接報、企業先期處理、出動環境應急處置力量、現場協同處置等行
                                   動。在準備期間，參與人員不斷改進、完善演練方案以盡可能地貼合實際發生場景。演練開始後，
                                   消防隊、醫療救護組、環境監測組、搶修組、工藝組等各應急救援隊伍迅速集結，果斷實施堵漏、
                                   噴淋、消防、救援等一系列行動，實現高效有序的配合。本次演練進一步提高了企業應對突發環境
                                   事件的應急處置能力，為守護環境安全奠定了紥實的基礎。

Example:    Tangshan Risun Chemicals carries out safety emergency drills to improve the emergency handling
案例：         ability
            唐山旭陽化工開展安全應急演練，提高應急處置能力


            On July 10, 2019, Tangshan Risun Chemicals undertook the Laoting County Chemical Fire-
            Fighting And Rescue Practice Drill. Upon occurrence of the disaster in this drill, the plant quickly
            started the emergency plan, organized the evacuation of nearby personnel, started the fire pump
            in the plant area, mobilized the plant process disposal team and the fire brigade of the company
            to the site for handling the disasters, and called the fire brigade. With the assistance of the
            chemical fire brigade send by the fire brigade, public security and traffic police, environmental
            protection department, and medical and other forces and the timely use of large fire-fighting
            equipment, the fire was effectively controlled in a short time. Through this safety emergency drill,
            the ability of Tangshan Risun Chemicals to deal with large safety accidents has improved, and
            the safety awareness of employees has been enhanced, which lay a foundation for the daily safe
            production and operation of the company and provide experience and reference for dealing with
            safety emergencies.
            2019年7月10日，唐山旭陽化工承辦了樂亭縣化工滅火救援實戰演練活動。此次演練災情發生後，
            廠區迅速啟動應急預案，組織附近人員疏散，啟動廠區消防泵，調集廠區工藝處置隊和企業消防隊
            到場處置，並向消防大隊報警。經過消防大隊派遣的化工消防隊、公安交警、環保、醫療等聯動力
            量到場協助，及時動用大型消防裝備後，火情在短時間內被有效控制。通過承辦此次安全應急演
            練，唐山旭陽化工處置大型安全事故的能力得到提升，員工安全意識增強，為企業日常安全生產運
            營奠定基礎，為應對安全應急事件提供經驗與借鑑方案。

                                   識；滄州旭陽化工以「防風險、除隱患、遏事故」為主題，開展了安全生產主體責任培訓、安全事故綜

                                  subjected to fine management. This warning education helped promote the cultivation of the habit

                                  and principles, and enhanced the awareness of employees against corruption, so as to ensure the

                                  開展。課程強調：幹部員工要將廉潔自律為信仰，植入思想意識，並在工作中重視機制與體制建設，

                                  識，提高員工反貪污意識，以確保廣大幹部員工的職業安全。

     The consolidated financial statements has been prepared                          綜合財務報表乃根據國際會計準則理

     consolidated financial statements includes applicable disclosures                此外，綜合財務報表包括聯交所證券
     required by the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the                 上市規則及香港公司條例規定的適用
     Stock Exchange and by the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.                         披露。

     The consolidated financial statements has been prepared on the                   綜合財務報表乃按歷史成本基準編
     historical cost basis except for certain financial instruments that              製，惟若干金融工具如下文載列的會

     explained in the accounting policies below.                                      量除外。

     consideration given in exchange for goods and services.                          易所付出代價的公允值。

     Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or               公允值是於計量日期由市場參與者於
     paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market            有秩序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓
     participants at the measurement date, regardless of whether that                 負債須支付的價格，而不論該價格是
     price is directly observable or estimated using another valuation                否直接可觀察或可使用其他估值技術
     technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability,              估計。若市場參與者於計量日期對資
     the Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or                 產或負債定價時會考慮資產或負債的
     liability if market participants would take those characteristics into           特點，則本集團於估計資產或負債的
     account when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement                   公允值時會考慮該等特點。綜合財務
     date. Fair value for measurement and/or disclosure purposes                      報表中作計量及╱或披露用途的公允
     in the consolidated financial statements is determined on such                   值乃按此基準釐定，惟根據國際財務
     a basis, except for leasing transactions that are accounted for                  報告準則第16號（自2019年1月1日起）
     in accordance with IFRS 16 (since January 1, 2019) or IAS 17                     或國際會計準則第17號（於應用國際財
     (before application of IFRS 16), and measurements that have some                 務報告準則第16號之前）入賬的租賃交
     similarities to fair value but are not fair value, such as net realizable        易，以及與公允值有部分相若地方但
     value in IAS 2 “Inventories” or value in use in IAS 36 “Impairment of            並非公允值的計量，譬如國際會計準
     Assets”.                                                                         則第2號「存貨」內的可變現淨值或國際
                                                                                      會計準則第36號「資產減值」的使用價值
                                                                                      除外。

     A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account             非金融資產的公允值計量須計及一名

     using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another          最佳用途或透過將資產出售予將使用
     market participant that would use the asset in its highest and best              其最高及最佳用途的另一名市場參與
     use.                                                                             者而能夠產生經濟利益的能力。

               Revenue from contracts with customers                                           客戶合約收益

               The Group recognizes revenue when (or as) a performance                         本集團於完成履約責任時（或就此）確認
               obligation is satisfied, i.e. when “control” of the products or services        收益，即於特定履約責任相關的產品
               underlying the particular performance obligation is transferred to              或服務的「控制權」轉讓予客戶時。
               the customers.

               A performance obligation represents a good or service (or a bundle              履約責任指一個明確貨品或服務（或一
               of goods or services) that is distinct or a series of distinct goods or         批明確貨品或服務）或一系列大致相同
               services that are substantially the same.                                       的明確貨品或服務。

               Control is transferred over time and revenue is recognized over                 倘符合以下其中一項條件，控制權會
               time by reference to the progress towards complete satisfaction of              按時間轉移，而收益則參考完全履行
               the relevant performance obligation if one of the following criteria is         相關履約責任的進度按時間確認：
               met:

               •      the customer simultaneously receives and consumes the                    •   於本集團履約時，客戶同時取得
                      benefits provided by the Group’s performance as the Group                    並耗用實體履約所提供的利益；
                      performs;

               •      the Group’s performance creates or enhances an asset that                •   本集團的履約創造及增強一項資
                      the customer controls as the Group performs; or                              產，而該項資產於本集團履約時
                                                                                                   由客戶控制；或

               •      the Group’s performance does not create an asset with                    •   本集團的履約並未創造讓本集團
                      an alternative use to the Group and the Group has an                         有替代用途的資產，且本集團對
                      enforceable right to payment for performance completed to                    迄今已完成履約的付款具有可強
                      date.                                                                        制執行的權利。

               Otherwise, revenue is recognized at a point in time when the                    否則，收益於客戶獲得商品或服務的
               customer obtains control of the goods or services.                              控制權的時點確認。

               A contract liability represents the Group’s obligation to transfer              合約負債指本集團向客戶轉移本集團
               goods or services to a customer for which the Group has received                已向客戶收取代價（或應收取代價金額）
               consideration (or an amount of consideration is due) from the                   的貨品或服務的責任。
               customer.

     Definition of default                                                           違約的定義

     For internal credit risk management, the Group considers an event               就內部信貸風險管理而言，當內部產
     of default occurs when information developed internally or obtained             生或獲取自外部來源的資料表明，債
     from external sources indicates that the debtor is unlikely to pay all          務人不太可能根據合約條款支付所有
     amounts due in accordance with the contractual terms.                           到期款項時，本集團認為構成違約事
                                                                                     件。

     Irrespective of the above, the Group considers that default has                 無論上述情況如何，倘一項金融資產
     occurred when a financial asset is more than 90 days past due                   已逾期超過90日，則本集團認為已產
     unless the Group has reasonable and supportable information                     生違約，除非本集團有合理及可靠資
     to demonstrate that a more lagging default criterion is more                    料證明較寬鬆的違約標準更為適用則
     appropriate.                                                                    當別論。

     Credit-impaired financial assets                                                已信貸減值金融資產

     A financial asset is credit-impaired when one or more events that               當一項或多項對金融資產預計未來現

     is credit-impaired includes observable data about the following                 值。金融資產出現信貸減值的證據包
     events:                                                                         括涉及以下事件的可觀察數據。

     •     significant financial difficulty of the issuer or the borrower;           •     發行方或借款人遇到嚴重財政困
                                                                                           難；

     •     a breach of contract, such as a default or past due event;                •     違反合約，如拖欠或逾期的情
                                                                                           況；

     •     the lender(s) of the borrower, for economic or contractual                •     向借款人作出貸款之貸款人出於
           reasons relating to the borrower’s financial difficulty, having                 與借款人財政困難有關的經濟或
           granted to the borrower a concession(s) that the lender(s)                      合約考慮，給予借款人在其他情
           would not otherwise consider;                                                   況下不會作出的讓步；

     •     it is becoming probable that the borrower will enter                      •     借款人有可能破產或進行其他財

       37. RESERVES                                                                      37. 儲備

               Share premium                                                                股份溢價

               Under the Companies Law (Revised) of the Cayman Islands,                     根據開曼群島公司法（經修訂），計入本
               amount included in the share premium account of the Company                  公司股份溢價賬中的金額可分派予本
               is distributable to the shareholders of the Company provided that            公司股東，前提是緊隨建議分派股息
               immediately following the date on which the dividend is proposed to          日期後本公司將有能力在日常業務過

               as and when they fall due in the ordinary course of business.

               Merger reserve                                                               合併儲備

               the aggregate capital of the subsidiaries acquired pursuant to the           資本之間的差額，根據合併會計基準
               Group Reorganization, accounted for as capital contribution from             作為最終控股公司的注資入賬。
               ultimate holding company under merger basis of accounting.

               Reserve fund                                                                 儲備基金

               The Articles of Association of certain PRC subsidiaries require the          若干中國附屬公司的組織章程細則要

               in capital of these subsidiaries.                                            等附屬公司的實收資本。

       40. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT                                                          40. 資本管理

               The Group’s primary objectives of managing capital are to                 本集團管理資本的主要目的是維護其
               safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern, and to      持續經營的能力，從而使其能夠透過
               provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders,     按合理成本取得融資，繼續為股東提
               by securing access to finance at a reasonable cost.                       供回報及為其他持份者提供利益。

               The Group actively and regularly reviews and manages its capital          本集團積極及定期檢討和管理其資本
               structure to maintain a balance between the higher shareholder            架構，以在維持較高借款水平可能帶
               returns that might be possible with higher levels of borrowings, and      來的高股東回報取得平衡，並因應不
               makes adjustments to the capital structure in light of changes in         同的經濟狀況為資本架構作出調整。
               economic conditions.

               Based on recommendations of the board of directors, the Group will        根據董事會建議，本集團將透過調整
               balance its overall capital structure through adjusting the amount        向股東派付的股息金額、發行新股、
               of dividends paid to shareholders, issuing of new shares, raising         籌集新債務融資或出售資產以減少債
               new debt financing or selling assets to reduce debt. During the           務，藉以平衡其整體資本架構。於報
               reporting period, there were no changes in the objectives, policies       告期內，並無更改目標、政策或程
               or processes.                                                             序。

               The Group monitors capital with reference to its debt position. The       本集團透過參考其債務狀況監察資
               Group’s strategy was to maintain the equity and debt in a balanced        本。本集團的策略為將權益與債項維
               position and ensure there was adequate working capital to service         持在一個平衡的位置，並確保擁有足
               its debt obligation.                                                      夠的營運資金償還其債務。
